summary: The filing reports a routine financing where Clearmind Medicine Inc. issued $1.5M principal of convertible promissory notes at 90% cash purchase price to existing CLA investors, closing same-day. No special-situation event (merger, tender, activism, restructuring, etc.) is present. Terms: notes convertible into equity per existing SPA, with no premium, strategic review, board change, or shareholder vote. This is a standard capital-raising facility, not a special situation.
